verdict.rationale: Square exposes webhooks and an MCP server that could let an AI agent trigger or observe events and act autonomously, but there's no documented native 'automation builder' or scheduled/background workflow feature in Square itself — it only provides raw APIs/events for developers to wire up their own automations. Missing for 10: evidence of a first-party automation/workflow engine, scheduling or trigger-action system, and confirmation that MCP server actions can run unattended in the background.
